status: conditional research protocol; source timezone, native unit metadata and measurement-use rights remain unresolved
timestamp_basis: Naive release timestamps; no timezone localization or DST correction. Calendar features are release-clock features, not verified local wall-clock features.
target: Sensor speed value at issue timestamp + horizon, in native release speed units
unit_convention: mph in published benchmark literature; HDF does not encode units; do not claim file-level confirmation or convert units without provider confirmation
target_validity: finite and > 0; zero is unavailable under author benchmark convention, not confirmed stopped traffic
issue_rule: All horizons share issue times: at least 12 historical ticks ending at t; t+60 minutes must remain strictly before the split end. Validation/test may use already released preceding split observations as lag context.
availability_assumption: Offline issue time occurs after observing the release value at t; source publication latency and aggregation start/end semantics are unknown, so no live-service claim.
features: release-clock target weekday and five-minute slot
last 12 readings ending at issue time with explicit missing masks
causal rolling statistics over that history only
missing_features: Keep NaN plus missing masks for XGBoost; causal summaries ignore invalid readings; any imputation medians fit training only. No backfill or interpolation from the future.
persistence: Most recent positive finite reading within the 12-step history; otherwise training-only sensor median, then global training median; report fallback coverage.
historical_average: Training-only mean for sensor/target weekday/five-minute slot; fallback to sensor/target weekday/hour mean, sensor median, global training median. Never update with validation/test targets.

xgboost_candidate.tuning: None for the first frozen candidate; any development tuning must use validation only and be recorded before final test scoring.

metric_units: Native release units; mph interpretation is literature-supported but not HDF-verified
mape: Not a primary metric; no zero-denominator manipulation
peak_definition: Target release-clock weekday Mon-Fri 07:00-09:00 or 16:00-19:00, half-open windows. Off-peak is the complement. These are fixed benchmark strata, not asserted verified LA local peaks.
reproducibility: Record data/metadata hashes, protocol hash, code commit, exact package versions and seed. Freeze train-only mappings/fallbacks and candidate before scoring test. No training occurred in Stage 8A.
clarification: Stage 8C user-specified rolling operators; frozen before XGBoost fitting or final-test scoring. No feature selection or tuning.

feature_contract.sensor_encoding: Lexicographically sorted unique sensor IDs with at least one positive finite TRAINING observation, mapped to contiguous zero-based integers; native XGBoost categorical feature. Reject unknown sensors. Mapping frozen before evaluation.
feature_contract.calendar_encoding: Numerical target weekday Monday=0..Sunday=6 and target five-minute slot 0..287, derived from unlocalized t+h. No cyclic expansion.
feature_contract.lags: Oldest to newest: t-11 ticks through t. Nonpositive/nonfinite readings become NaN. Each corresponding missing mask is 1 when unavailable and 0 otherwise.
feature_contract.rolling: Same 12 readings, positive finite only; float64 accumulation then float32 storage; mean, population standard deviation ddof=0, minimum, maximum, valid count. Minimum valid count=1. For zero valid readings, all four speed summaries are NaN and count=0; for one reading, std=0.
feature_contract.preprocessing: No scaling, clipping or imputation. No additional features.
feature_contract.row_order: Issue timestamp ascending, then original HDF sensor column order. Training retains all and only positive finite horizon targets.

selection_rule: Lowest validation MAE per horizon; exact ties resolved in order persistence, historical_average, xgboost. No retuning or refitting on validation.
